_readme: Amr's own recorded narration (audio/narration/amr_raw/, gitignored). Each segment: take file, trim in/out (s, within the take), cue (s, absolute in the film), and the caption text as spoken (Whisper transcript, corrected for obvious mis-hearings). scripts/assemble_vo.py builds processed/audio/vo_white_friday.wav + captions from this.

segments.text: Here is my best life hack since moving to Dubai.
My work takes me all over the UAE, so I open Privilee and find a place to train around my day.
Different gyms keep it interesting, and having options is what keeps me consistent.
Weights one day, Muay Thai the next.
And with eligible memberships, it even works in Qatar, Oman and more countries.
Then the weekend comes, and I slow down by the pool or at the beach.
And for the White Friday, three months in the UAE, Qatar, Bahrain or Oman, valid in the country where you subscribe.
